issues.description: Fixed-packet buffer has no stated invariant or pacing analysis
issues.detail: The new buffer loop emits chunks of size N while leftover bytes accumulate. The invariant ('len(buffer) < packet_bytes at exit; buffer prefix is the next emission') is not stated, and there is no analysis of whether the while-loop can burst-send many packets back-to-back, defeating the 'real-time pacing' goal claimed in the changelog. State the invariant and document the pacing relationship to _next_send_time.

issues.description: fixed_audio_packet_size has no validation or unit documentation
issues.detail: The field accepts any Optional[int]; zero, negative, or odd values (for 16-bit PCM) will silently misbehave: zero causes infinite loop in `while len >= 0`, odd values split samples mid-frame. The docstring promises '20ms @ 16kHz PCM16 mono = 640' but never states the formula (rate * channels * bytes_per_sample * ms / 1000). Validate >0 and document the formula literately.

issues.description: Non-audio payloads bypass buffer, violating ordering invariant
issues.detail: When fixed_audio_packet_size is set and a bytes audio payload arrives with remainder buffered, a subsequent non-bytes payload (e.g., JSON 'clear' from VonageFrameSerializer InterruptionFrame) is sent immediately via the fall-through, overtaking buffered audio still pending. InterruptionFrame clears the buffer, but other JSON commands do not. State and preserve a FIFO ordering invariant across payload types.

issues.description: DTMF parsing accepts two undocumented shapes without a stated contract
issues.detail: deserialize tries `message.get('digit')` then `message.get('dtmf', {}).get('digit')`. The comment says 'Vonage may send digit in different formats' but cites no spec. A reader cannot tell which shape is canonical or whether this is defensive coding versus actual protocol variance. Link the Vonage doc or pick one shape; faith-based parsing is the anti-pattern Knuth flags.

Both serialize and deserialize check `is None or len() == 0` on resampler output and treat it as bytes downstream. The expected type and the 'empty-means-skip' contract of create_stream_resampler is not stated in this file. A careful reader has to chase the resampler implementation to confirm. One docstring line or a type hint fixes it.

review.summary: The Vonage serializer is straightforward and mostly correct, but it is UNDER-AUDITED at the boundaries: resampler contracts and DTMF shape variance are accepted on faith rather than stated. The FastAPIWebsocket packetization buffer is the more consequential change and earns NEEDS-LITERATE-COMMENT: the loop has no stated invariant, no input validation (zero would loop forever, odd sizes split PCM samples), no documented byte-count formula, and an ordering hazard where buffered audio can be overtaken by non-bytes payloads. None of these are wrong by analysis I can construct; they are unproven by the code as written. Add invariants, validate fixed_audio_packet_size>0, and document the FIFO ordering contract before merge.
